hypothesis: For this single-group full-attention workload, instruction count is driven by cached-prefix traversal and fixed branch costs for existing versus newly needed blocks.

pcvs.name: prefix_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Counts cached prefix blocks potentially inspected when determining allocation requirements.

pcvs.name: has_prefix_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures fixed overhead of handling a nonempty cached prefix.

pcvs.name: has_existing_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes initial allocation from requests with an existing block table.

pcvs.name: needs_additional_blocks
pcvs.rationale: Captures the branch where existing and prefix blocks cannot cover the requested token slots.
